\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m7qe5mp9kd1h5ekae19zkdfd
+  text: |-
+    Research and measurements (2026-11-18):
+    - A window-less NSHostingView cannot scroll a SwiftUI ScrollView. The DocumentView of the scroll view has a zero frame. A ScrollPosition.scrollTo, a clip view origin change and one non-waiting run loop pass do not move the rows. The LazyVStack shows rows 0..4 and makes about 10 models at mount. Thus a headless test cannot measure which far rows the real LazyVStack keeps. The proof of the bound does not depend on LazyVStack.
+    - The new test shows the real ItemRows in a VStack (it keeps each row, the worst case of a lazy stack) and moves the rows in view with LiveRowRange.noteVisible(positions:), the call that ConversationView makes. RED: 80 answers, 4 rows in view, scroll from top to bottom: each editor stayed alive (bound 36). GREEN after the change.
+    - AppKit does not free an NSTextView at its last release in a window-less test process, also a plain NSTextView() that no SwiftUI view held. So the test counts the EditorTextScaffold (delegate of the text view) of each editor with weak references. A probe showed that the model and the scaffold of a removed RenderedMarkdownView are freed at once. An async test with Task.yield did not change the count of text views.
+    - Design: LiveRowRange (Thread/, @Observable, internal): rows in view +- 16 rows (margin); the range moves only when the rows in view come nearer than 8 rows (slack) to an end. ConversationView owns one and puts it in the environment. ResponseView: when its row is out of the range, it shows Color.clear at the height of its last layout (LaidOutHeight, not observable), with the same accessibility identifier and value. RenderedMarkdownView and its OwnModelSlot go, so the model goes. A response that was never laid out, or whose editor holds the thread selection (ResponseSelectionClaim, a TextSelectionRegion between the editor and ThreadTextSelection), keeps its editor. A text that streams in while the row is far shows whole at the next mount (new model from the text).
+    - Public API: no change. ARCHITECTURE.md has a new section "Models of rows far from view".
+    - Open (not in this change): CodeBlockView, CommandOutputView, TerminalView and the diff PreviewField of a row keep their models. A host CodeBlockModelCache still keeps every model (only tests set one). A placeholder keeps its old height after a width change until its row comes back. After a long jump (minimap, Show Error) a row that was laid out before can show its empty space for one frame, until the list reports the new rows.
